name: Clos des Lambrays
rightsHistoryPurpose: Official filiation, dated legal-entity rights and original-reference evidence for Clos des Lambrays (#461). None establishes current farming.

reviewedUncoveredArea.note: The measured 435.799819 m² remainder (0.4958%) was reviewed against the pinned INAO boundary and Chambolle-Musigny and Morey-Saint-Denis cadastres. The largest piece is a 1.25 m strip along the cru's northern side; the rest are narrow strips at the eastern edge and between parcels. It forms 10 pieces, with mean widths of 0.05–1.25 m for those of at least 1 m². 62.592626 m² lies between parcels inside the outline and the rest along its edge. It is not a missing INAO commune. 435.799819 m² is covered by no audited parcel. No geometry is added, clipped, buffered or filled. The absolute cap allows less than 0.1 m² above this reviewed measurement; changed source hashes require another review.

namedPlots.coverageNote: Clos des Lambrays, Les Bouchots and Meix-Rentier are cadastral named areas within Clos des Lambrays; the cadastre records the first as LES LARRETS OU CLOS DES LAMBRAYS. Outlines follow the cadastre inside the official boundary, with small gaps retained; they do not show producer holdings. A label naming only the cru keeps the whole-cru outline.
